mapper.select: SELECT REQ_TP as "reqTp", LINE_NM as "lineNm", USE_YN as "useYn", UPDT_DT as "updtDt", UPDT_USER_ID as "updtUserId" FROM TB_APRV_LINE ORDER BY REQ_TP

SELECT S.REQ_TP as "reqTp", S.STEP_NO as "stepNo", S.STEP_NM as "stepNm", S.APRVR_TP as "aprvrTp", S.APRVR_ID as "aprvrId", S.AGREE_YN as "agreeYn", CASE S.APRVR_TP WHEN 'USER' THEN (SELECT U.NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = S.APRVR_ID) WHEN 'ROLE' THEN (SELECT R.ROLE_NM FROM TB_ROLE R WHERE R.ROLE_ID = S.APRVR_ID) END as "aprvrNm" FROM TB_APRV_LINE_STEP S WHERE S.REQ_TP = #{reqTp} ORDER BY S.STEP_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_APRV_LINE (REQ_TP, LINE_NM, USE_YN, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{reqTp}, #{lineNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useYn}, #{now}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (REQ_TP) DO UPDATE SET LINE_NM = EXCLUDED.LINE_NM, USE_YN = EXCLUDED.USE_YN, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
INSERT INTO TB_APRV_LINE_STEP (REQ_TP, STEP_NO, STEP_NM, APRVR_TP, APRVR_ID, AGREE_YN) VALUES (#{reqTp}, #{stepNo}, #{stepNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aprvrTp}, #{aprvrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{agreeYn})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT UR.USER_ID FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = UR.USER_ID AND COALESCE(U.DEL_YN, false) = false WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY UR.USER_ID
SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_USER WHERE ADM_YN = true AND COALESCE(DEL_YN, false) = false ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT COALESCE(NM, USER_ID) FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND COALESCE(DEL_YN, false) = false
SELECT ORG_ID FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT P_ORG_ID as "pOrgId", HEAD_USER_ID as "headUserId" FROM TB_ORG WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_APRV_DOC (DOC_ID, REQ_TP, TARGET_ID, TARGET_NM, DM_ID, DICT_ID, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_DT, DOC_STAT, CUR_STEP_NO, STEP_CNT) VALUES (#{docId}, #{reqTp}, #{targetId}, #{targetNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dictId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqUserId}, #{now}, 'PROGRESS', 1, #{stepCnt})
INSERT INTO TB_APRV_DOC_STEP (DOC_ID, STEP_NO, APRVR_USER_ID, STEP_NM, AGREE_YN, ACT_STAT) VALUES (#{docId}, #{stepNo}, #{aprvrUserId}, #{stepNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{agreeYn}, 'WAIT')
mapper.sql: D.DOC_ID as "docId", D.REQ_TP as "reqTp", D.TARGET_ID as "targetId", D.TARGET_NM as "targetNm", D.DM_ID as "dmId", D.DICT_ID as "dictId", D.REQ_USER_ID as "reqUserId", (SELECT U.NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = D.REQ_USER_ID) as "reqUserNm", D.REQ_DT as "reqDt", D.DOC_STAT as "docStat", D.CUR_STEP_NO as "curStepNo", D.STEP_CNT as "stepCnt", D.END_DT as "endDt", (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(U.NM, S.APRVR_USER_ID), ', ' ORDER BY S.APRVR_USER_ID) FROM TB_APRV_DOC_STEP S LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = S.APRVR_USER_ID WHERE S.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID AND S.STEP_NO = D.CUR_STEP_NO AND S.ACT_STAT = 'WAIT') as "curAprvrNms"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_APRV_DOC D WHERE D.DOC_ID = #{docId}
SELECT FROM TB_APRV_DOC D WHERE D.REQ_TP = #{reqTp} AND D.TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND D.DOC_STAT = 'PROGRESS'
SELECT FROM TB_APRV_DOC D WHERE D.DOC_STAT = 'PROGRESS' AND D.TARGET_ID IN #{t}

SELECT S.STEP_NO as "stepNo", S.STEP_NM as "stepNm", S.AGREE_YN as "agreeYn", S.APRVR_USER_ID as "aprvrUserId", (SELECT U.NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = S.APRVR_USER_ID) as "aprvrUserNm", S.ACT_STAT as "actStat", S.ACT_CMNT as "actCmnt", S.ACT_DT as "actDt", S.ACT_USER_ID as "actUserId" FROM TB_APRV_DOC_STEP S WHERE S.DOC_ID = #{docId} ORDER BY S.STEP_NO, S.APRVR_USER_ID

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WORD WHERE WORD_ID = #{targetId} AND APRV_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TERMS WHERE TERMS_ID = #{targetId} AND APRV_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN WHERE DOMAIN_ID = #{targetId} AND APRV_YN = 'N'
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CHANGE_HISTORY WHERE SUBMISSION_ID = #{targetId} AND APRV_STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TB_APRV_DOC D
D.DOC_STAT = 'PROGRESS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_APRV_DOC_STEP S WHERE S.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID AND S.STEP_NO = D.CUR_STEP_NO AND S.APRVR_USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.ACT_STAT = 'WAIT')
D.REQ_USER_ID = #{userId}
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_APRV_DOC_STEP S WHERE S.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID AND S.ACT_USER_ID = #{userId})
D.DOC_STAT = 'PROGRESS'
AND D.REQ_TP = #{reqTp}
ORDER BY D.REQ_DT DESC, D.DOC_ID LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRV_DOC D WHERE D.DOC_STAT = 'PROGRESS' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_APRV_DOC_STEP S WHERE S.DOC_ID = D.DOC_ID AND S.STEP_NO = D.CUR_STEP_NO AND S.APRVR_USER_ID = #{userId} AND S.ACT_STAT = 'WAIT')

choose.when: SELECT WORD_ID as "id", WORD_NM as "nm", WORD_ENG_NM as "engNm", WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM as "engAbrvNm", WORD_DESC as "desc", WORD_CLSF_YN as "wordClsfYn", DOMAIN_CLSF_NM as "domainClsfNm", DICT_ID as "dictId", APRV_YN as "aprvYn", CRET_USER_ID as "cretUserId", CRET_DT as "cretDt" FROM TB_WORD WHERE WORD_ID = #{targetId}

SELECT TERMS_ID as "id", TERMS_NM as "nm", TERMS_ENG_ABRV_NM as "engAbrvNm", TERMS_DESC as "desc", DOMAIN_NM as "domainNm", CODE_GRP as "codeGrp", DICT_ID as "dictId", APRV_YN as "aprvYn", CRET_USER_ID as "cretUserId", CRET_DT as "cretDt", (SELECT string_agg(W.WORD_NM || '(' || W.WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM || CASE WHEN W.APRV_YN = 'N' THEN ', 승인 대기' ELSE '' END || ')', ' + ' ORDER BY TW.WORD_ORD) FROM TB_TERMS_WORDS TW JOIN TB_WORD W ON W.WORD_ID = TW.WORD_ID WHERE TW.TERMS_ID = T.TERMS_ID) as "words" FROM TB_TERMS T WHERE TERMS_ID = #{targetId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT DOMAIN_ID as "id", DOMAIN_NM as "nm", DOMAIN_DESC as "desc", DATA_TYPE as "dataType", DATA_LEN as "dataLen", DATA_DECIMAL_LEN as "dataDecimalLen", DOMAIN_GRP_NM as "domainGrpNm", DOMAIN_CLSF_NM as "domainClsfNm", DICT_ID as "dictId", APRV_YN as "aprvYn", CRET_USER_ID as "cretUserId", CRET_DT as "cretDt" FROM TB_DOMAIN WHERE DOMAIN_ID = #{targetId}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WORD WHERE WORD_ENG_ABRV_NM = #{engAbrvNm} AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} AND WORD_ID <> #{targetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_TERMS SET TERMS_DESC = #{desc}, UPDT_DT = #{now}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE TERMS_ID = #{targetId} AND APRV_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TB_DOMAIN SET DOMAIN_DESC = #{desc}, UPDT_DT = #{now}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE DOMAIN_ID = #{targetId} AND APRV_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_NOTIFICATION (USER_ID, NOTI_TP, TITLE, MSG, LINK_TP, LINK_ID, READ_YN, CRET_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notiTp}, #{title}, #{msg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_YN = 'N'

SELECT O.ORG_ID as "orgId", O.ORG_NM as "orgNm", O.P_ORG_ID as "pOrgId", O.HEAD_USER_ID as "headUserId", (SELECT U.NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = O.HEAD_USER_ID) as "headUserNm", O.SORT_ORD as "sortOrd", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.ORG_ID = O.ORG_ID AND COALESCE(U.DEL_YN, false) = false) as "userCnt" FROM TB_ORG O WHERE O.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY O.SORT_ORD, O.ORG_NM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORG WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ORG (ORG_ID, ORG_NM, P_ORG_ID, HEAD_USER_ID, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{orgNm}, #{pOrgId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{headUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrd}, 'Y', #{now}, #{userId}, #{now}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORG WHERE P_ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET ORG_ID = NULL WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID as "userId", NM as "userNm", EMAIL as "email" FROM TB_USER WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND COALESCE(DEL_YN, false) = false ORDER BY NM, USER_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET ORG_ID = #{orgId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
